name: Ladylike handbag
summary: The neat, matched handbag of the 1950s and early 1960s. It is a rigid calfskin box with a top handle and a turn-lock, or a quilted flap bag on a chain. The wearer carries it on the arm with gloves and a small hat.

philosophy.core_thesis: A lady's bag completes her outfit, and it is small, firm and kept in order.
design_principles: Build a firm box on a frame, 20 to 30 cm wide, that stands on its own.
Hold the bag by a short top handle, 8 to 12 cm tall, or on the forearm.
Close the flap with a brass turn-lock or a kiss clasp.
Quilt a soft skin in diamond rows of 3 to 4 cm, and hang it on a chain strap.
Match the bag to the shoes and the gloves.
Line the inside in silk twill, with a pocket for a mirror and a purse.
Make the stitches small and even, 8 to 10 to the cm, by hand.
Keep the hardware small, gold in tone and plain.
anti_patterns: A soft slouch bag with no frame
A large logo plate on the front

silhouette.shape: A small, firm box or a flat flap bag with a clean outline and square or softly rounded corners.
silhouette.line: A level top edge, a straight flap and a short handle that stands up.
silhouette.fit: The bag is carried on the forearm or held in the gloved hand; the chain version hangs from the shoulder at the hip.
silhouette.proportion: Box bag 20–30 cm wide, 15–20 cm high and 8–12 cm deep; handle drop 8–12 cm; chain strap 55–60 cm.
rules: Keep the shape rigid with a frame and a stiff lining.
Set one lock or one clasp at the centre of the flap.
Match the colour of the bag to the shoes, the gloves or the hat.
Carry no more on the surface than a quilted pattern or a clasp.

fabrics.rule: Use a fine leather that holds a frame: calfskin for the box, kid for the quilted bag, patent for the evening; line it in silk.

methods: diamond quilting on a padded skin
construction.closures: A brass turn-lock on the flap, a kiss clasp on a frame bag, or a clasp with a metal bar.
construction.details: A short top handle, an inner pocket for a mirror, a small foot at each corner and a stamp of the house inside the flap.

surface.pattern: Plain leather in one colour; a diamond quilt on the flap; a thin line of stitching at the edge.
surface.gloss: Calfskin at 20–35 GU; patent leather at 85–100 GU; gilt hardware at 80–90 GU.
surface.wear: The bag wants to look new and pressed: scuffs and bent corners spoil the shape, and the maker re-dyes and re-forms it.

palette.strategy: One neutral leather colour, matched to the shoes, with gilt metal for the hardware.

making.scale: Leather workshops made the best bags in small numbers by hand; couture houses and shops sold a range in standard sizes.
making.signs: Even stitches, painted edges, a lining that fits the frame and a lock that turns with no play.

pieces.form: Top-handle box bag with a flap and a turn-lock
Quilted flap bag with a gilt chain strap
Frame bag with a kiss clasp in patent leather
Short kid gloves with a button at the wrist

positive: quilted flap bag with a gilt chain

emotion.target_response: A sense of order and polish: the bag is small and neat, and it shows that the wearer plans her outfit.

use_cases: a costume brief for a 1950s film
a fashion image prompt with a 1950s lady
avoid_when: the brief is a casual, soft or sports bag
the brief wants a big, bold logo

modifiers.how: Cover the flap with a repeat monogram and add a large metal initial on the clasp.
Drop the clasp plate and the quilt; use plain calfskin with a single hand-sewn seam.

ornament_level.note: The surface carries a quilt or a clasp and no more.
